+ "Analyze the image to generate a structured schema for identified textual content.\nIdentify and extract transaction data from documents such as receipts, invoices, or bills, using the specified schema guidelines. Extract and structure the data into the provided schema while strictly following these rules:\nExtraction Rules\nTransaction-Level Fields:\n1. merchantName:\n  - Extract the merchant or business name exactly as it appears on the document.\n  - This is typically found at the top of receipts/invoices.\n\n2. transactionPlace:\n  - Classify the type of establishment using the provided category options (e.g., Restaurant, Cafe, Pharmacy, Hotel, etc.).\n  - Determine this by examining item descriptions, logos, or identifiable markers on the document.\n\n3. transactionDate:\n  - Extract the transaction date and time in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.\n  - If year is not defined, use 0000. If month/day is not defined, use 00.\n  - Time (THH:mm) is optional and should only be included if specified.\n  - Examples: \"2025-12-01T05:00\", \"0000-07-19\", \"0000-00-00\"\n\n4. total:\n  - Extract the final total amount of the transaction.\n\n5. subTotal:\n  - Extract the subtotal amount (before taxes and tips) if available.\n\n6. currency:\n  - Extract the currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY) - no symbols allowed.\n  - Refer to standard currency codes if needed.\n\n7. taxes:\n  - Extract all tax charges as a list of objects with \"chargeDescription\" and \"chargePrice\".\n  - Examples: Sales Tax, VAT, GST\n\n8. tips:\n  - Extract all tip/gratuity charges as a list of objects with \"chargeDescription\" and \"chargePrice\".\n\n9. otherCharges:\n  - Extract any other charges (not taxes or tips) as a list of objects with \"chargeDescription\" and \"chargePrice\".\n  - Examples: Service Fee, Delivery Fee, Convenience Fee\n\nTransaction Item Extraction Rules:\n10. items:\n  - Extract all items involved in the transaction, including discounts and complimentary items.\n  - Each item should include:\n    - quantity: Record as an integer.\n    - itemDescription: Capture exactly as written, preserving all formatting and order. Do not add total price or quantity information.\n    - totalPrice: The price directly aligned with the item. For discounts, use negative values.\n    - modifiers: List any item customizations (e.g., \"Add Dressing\", \"No Onions\") with optional prices.\n\nExtraction Rules:\n- Text Direction: Read and interpret text in a left-to-right and top-to-bottom order.\n- Comprehensive Capture: Ensure every character and relevant detail is preserved without alteration or omission.\n- Multiple-line Items: Combine multi-line items, maintaining their sequence.\n- Consistency Across Document Types: Apply these guidelines regardless of document type.\n- Verify Sum Accuracy: Ensure that the sum of items' totalPrice matches the document's declared total.\n\nProhibited Actions:\n- Exclude items without prices, like category headers or non-retail identifiers.\n- Only include prices that are directly part of the completed transaction. Exclude menu listings or ticket prices not tied to the transaction.\n\nHere are some examples:\n\nSimple restaurant transaction:\n[{\"transaction\": {\"merchantName\": \"Joe's Diner\", \"transactionPlace\": \"Restaurant\", \"transactionDate\": \"2025-01-15T12:30\", \"total\": 32.50, \"subTotal\": 28.00, \"currency\": \"USD\", \"items\": [{\"quantity\": 2, \"itemDescription\": \"FISH & CHIPS\", \"totalPrice\": 14.50}, {\"quantity\": 1, \"itemDescription\": \"Harvest Salad\", \"totalPrice\": 12.00, \"modifiers\": [{\"modifierDescription\": \"Add Dressing\", \"modifierPrice\": 2.00}, {\"modifierDescription\": \"Member discount\", \"modifierPrice\": -1.00}]}], \"taxes\": [{\"chargeDescription\": \"Sales Tax\", \"chargePrice\": 2.50}], \"tips\": [{\"chargeDescription\": \"Tip\", \"chargePrice\": 2.00}]}}]\n\nTransaction with partial item name and modifier without price:\n[{\"transaction\": {\"merchantName\": \"Burger Palace\", \"transactionPlace\": \"Restaurant\", \"transactionDate\": \"0000-03-20\", \"total\": 5.75, \"currency\": \"USD\", \"items\": [{\"quantity\": 1, \"itemDescription\": \"Cheeseburger multigr\", \"totalPrice\": 5.75, \"modifiers\": [{\"modifierDescription\": \"*No onion*\"}]}]}}]\n\nPharmacy transaction with other charges:\n[{\"transaction\": {\"merchantName\": \"HealthPlus Pharmacy\", \"transactionPlace\": \"Pharmacy\", \"transactionDate\": \"2025-02-10T14:15\", \"total\": 28.50, \"subTotal\": 25.00, \"currency\": \"USD\", \"items\": [{\"quantity\": 1, \"itemDescription\": \"Vitamin D3\", \"totalPrice\": 15.00}, {\"quantity\": 2, \"itemDescription\": \"Pain Relief\", \"totalPrice\": 10.00}], \"taxes\": [{\"chargeDescription\": \"Tax\", \"chargePrice\": 2.00}], \"otherCharges\": [{\"chargeDescription\": \"Delivery Fee\", \"chargePrice\": 1.50}]}}]\n\nIf you cannot find any useful transactions, please return empty list '[]' in your response.\n\nRespond in JSON only in the format defined by the schema."
